newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: SLOVAK SIGNS POLISH PETROL STATION JV DEAL.
newsitem.headline: SLOVAK SIGNS POLISH PETROL STATION JV DEAL.

text.p: Slovakia's sole crude oil refiner Slovnaft a.s. said on Thursday it had signed a contract creating a joint-venture to build and operate up to some 30 petrol stations in Poland by the year 2000.

Slovnaft spokesman Lubomir Zitnan told Reuters the Krakow-based venture would be called Slovnaft-Polska a.s. and would carry Slovnaft's logo. He declined to provide any further details, including the name of the Polish partner.
The venture's first station should begin operations around the end of the year, Zitnan said.
Slovnaft currently has a 25-strong chain in the Czech Republic, and two "trial" petrol stations in the Ukraine.
Slovnaft controls some 310 petrol stations in Slovakia, accounting for over 75 percent of the domestic market.
